text:
jordan: noticed an OOM on shard-prod-7 at ~03:42 UTC. Symptoms look different from prior "sticky residency" incidents  bump in small-object survivors after nightly compaction. attaching quick scrape: https://logs.company/oom/1718200000

priya: can you paste the scrape?

jordan: paste from mem-exporter:
```
node.heap_total_mb: 18432
node.heap_used_mb: 17980 -> 21120 (3h)
kv.residency.live_objects: 850k -> 2.1M
kv.avg_obj_size_bytes: 64 -> 72
gc.total_pauses_ms: 600 -> 980
write.batch.size: 5k spikes during compaction windows
```

ken: hmm, avg obj size shift + compaction window correlation. could be fragmentation due to small slab churn. i can run slab-prof to get per-slab retention. will own slab profiling.

yu: i'll take GC tuning experiments. exploring write-side backpressure and async frees. target: test settings in staging by Thu.

rachel: i'll coordinate canary rollout of a soft-eviction threshold and add canary dashboards. plan: soft-evict at 75% and run for 72h on 3 nodes.

jordan: can we list discrete follow-ups to add to the postmortem tracker? short bullets pls.

ken: Action: slab profiling + top retention buckets -> owner: ken -> due: 2026-03-27 -> success: identify top 5 slabs and PRs to reduce allocation churn

yu: Action: GC/config experiments (async free, increment compaction) -> owner: yu -> due: 2026-03-26 -> success: staging reproduces lower pause tail and no increase in latency

rachel: Action: canary soft-evict rollout + dashboard -> owner: rachel -> due: 2026-03-28 -> success: soft-evict shows <3% request errors, 12% drop in peak total residency

priya: Action: create synthetic workload that reproduces compaction spike -> owner: priya -> due: 2026-03-25 -> success: local/staging replay reproduces object survivor growth

jordan: Action: add weekly residency delta alert and add to oncall runbook -> owner: jordan -> due: 2026-03-24 -> success: alert documented and tested in staging

ops-bot: Created issue: INF-4833 - "Small-object survivor spike after compaction / OOM followups" (https://jira.company/browse/INF-4833). Assigned: ken, yu, rachel, priya, jordan.

ken: note: i'll capture flamegraphs + object histograms and attach to the issue.

priya: i'll fork the tests repo and add a compaction-heavy workload variant: https://git.company/tests/kv-compaction-sim

yu: adding an autoscale rule proposal to INF-4833: trigger when residency delta > 1.8x in 10m AND sustained for 15m. will simulate in staging.

rachel: scheduling 30m check-in 2026-03-26 11:00 PST to review canary metrics. calendar invite sent.

jordan: please paste PR links and dashboards into INF-4833. i'll post a nightly summary to #eng-oncall for the week.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-4833: "New variant observed: small-object survivor growth tied to compaction windows. Follow-ups assigned; canary + profiling in flight."

ken: starting slab profiling run in staging now.

priya: tests added to repo, pushing branch now.

yu: running GC experiments in staging cluster. will report perf numbers later today.

rachel: canary config uploaded to infra repo: https://git.company/infra/canaries/soft-evict-75.yaml

jordan: thanks team. we'll reconvene after canary window and decide broader mitigations (eviction heuristics, API-level quotas, alloc-site fixes). :white_check_mark:

priya: ack. will post reproduction steps and links to INF-4833.

ken: will attach slab metrics and initial analysis by Fri EOD.

yu: aiming for GC experiment results by Thu EOD.

rachel: will post canary dashboard after 24h and final results after 72h.

jordan: end.
